selected_evidence.requirement: Writable projects share for the design team
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the projects-only configuration, active service/listeners, authenticated listing and reads, two successive writes, and matching round-trip hashes.
Guest tree connections return ACCESS_DENIED; the private sibling returns BAD_NETWORK_NAME; traversal is rejected. Denials remain effective after restarts.
Pre-change and final SHA-256 hashes for drawing.txt, materials.csv, and private/contracts.txt match; post-restart reads from node2 match those hashes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Alpine Linux 3.23 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts before and after configuration and reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID bf394c6d-5c4e-4238-bd94-7d1a746ea3b8, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 70dcbd51-374a-42c8-9892-5bc014fb7be2, automatic Samba recovery, persistent hashes, and remote authenticated read/write are proven.

Healthy baseline boot ID b65561e8-2b39-4898-8c99-75aacc0330bf, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 0238081e-f9b2-4189-9837-4596d7a2e464, and recovered authenticated list/read/update behavior are proven.
